items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: In passing where they buried her, I saw Bert Williams' tomb.

ctx.x: Lloyd Phillips' first wife. She died with TB. And we were working together. He said, 'I've got to go to the hospital. My wife ain't gonna make it.' That's what he told me. So then I went to her funeral. It was me, him and her brother. We went out to Woodlawn Cemetery, the first time I saw that, when you go to the grave and they put the body in the ground. It was snowing and there was ice on the ground. Cold, cold out. Since I'd come to New York... I'd been in New York, what, about three or four months. And in the…
